Caleb Dunne

A Division Agent and the lead character of Extremis Malis, whose pursuit of Mantis follows a fatal New York warehouse operation into the Division 2 prequel's East Coast story.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

From New York to Philadelphia

Caleb begins the graphic novel as a Division Agent on a Chinatown warehouse operation. The killing of his partner turns the case into a pursuit that carries the prequel beyond Manhattan. [1]
